tool_arguments.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create one full-body visual-novel sprite of Xianyun expressing love-1, using only the supplied approved neutral as image reference. Preserve her identity, face, skin tone, glasses, hair, ornaments, costume, color palette, artwork style and Tall Female proportions. Give her an openly joyful affectionate smile, raised brows, a gentle sideways lean, one hand near her heart and the other relaxed. Both eyes must be open and clearly visible behind her glasses, looking toward the viewer. Preserve the intact teal irises, including their original outline, iris detail, shading and a visible teal border around each pupil. In the center of each iris place exactly one solid, clearly defined pale aqua heart-shaped pupil, with matching shape and size in both eyes. The hearts replace only the pupils; they are not highlights, entire irises, floating symbols or extra marks. Keep the eye shapes natural and symmetrical. Hands simple near the torso, each visible hand with one thumb and four fingers naturally connected to the palm; exactly two legs and feet. Show the complete silhouette including hair, hands and shoes, with approximately 2–4% padding at top and bottom. True transparent background. No scenery, text, UI, weapons, companions, floating effects, watermark or ground shadow.
